thread:
dalia: Heads-up — structured-output eval failing on quantized model bring-up (llama-v3-small-q4). CI flaky failure in toolcall schema validator, repros intermittently in CI only :grimacing:

samir: Ack. Seeing the same CI failure on yesterday's run. Quick error snippet from runner logs:
```json
{"error":"SchemaValidationError","path":"response.tools[0].args","expected":"object","got":"string","test_id":"eval-toolcall-142"}
```

andrew: Is this the metric mismatch we've seen? Dashboard shows function_call_success = 100% for that run but schema_failures = 3. That suggests the function-call success metric is measured before schema validation or tags are wrong. @dalia can you paste the metric emission point?

dalia: Metric emitted in runner at the toolcall wrapper exit. Pseudocode: `emit_metric("func_call_success", ok)` right after `invoke_tool()` return. The schema validator runs later in the harness so yeah could be ordering bug.

ravi: Another possibility — quantized model is emitting escaped JSON for args, so the runtime returns a string that contains JSON, e.g.:
```json
{"name":"create_event","args":"{\"title\":\"Q2 sync\",\"time\":\"10:00\"}"}
```
If the schema expects args: object, validator fails but func_call_success still treats it as success because the tool itself returned a string payload.

samir: I can reproduce locally with the q4 config when forcing shorter kv cache. Repro command I ran:
```bash
pytest tests/evals/test_toolcalls.py::test_nested_toolcall -k quant -q -s
```
Locally I get the same SchemaValidationError about args being string ~70% of runs.

andrew: Fix plan:
- change metric timing: emit func_call_success after schema validation or add a separate metric func_call_schema_ok with tags.
- add a unit that asserts `type(response.tools[0].args) is dict` for toolcall tests
- add a small transform in the runner that attempts to parse string args as JSON if schema expects object (best-effort) and log parse attempts

dalia: Sounds good. I'll open a tiny PR for metric reorder + new metric. Can we add the parsing fallback as opt-in with a flag `--lenient-toolcall-parse`? Don't want silent behavior by default.

ravi: SG. Also let's add a regression test on the dashboard reporting side: ensure `func_call_schema_ok` <= `func_call_attempts` and correlate with schema_failures. Right now the visualization sums different tags incorrectly.

samir: I'll file an incident/bug: https://redwood.internal/issue/3214 — includes CI logs and the failing test. Putting repro steps + minimal failing output.

ci-bot: CI pipeline #build/7865 failed: tests/evals/test_toolcalls.py::test_nested_toolcall (quantized) — rerun queued

andrew: @dalia @samir assignable tasks? I can take dashboard tags and metric renaming, ravi can do parser fallback, samir handle CI flaky test stabilization, dalia metric reorder + PR.

dalia: Assigning now. I'll attach the PR here once opened. Planning to land metric reorder + func_call_schema_ok before EOD. :thumbsup:

samir: I'll add the unit test and mark the CI job as allow_failure temporarily until we stabilize.

ravi: I'll prototype the `--lenient-toolcall-parse` and run it against the local q4 binary. If it reduces failures we can decide to enable per-deploy.

andrew: Great. Also add an eval that checks the runner's JSON roundtrip for quantized runs specifically (tokenization/escape regression). We don't have a coverage gate for that.

dalia: Noted. Linking dashboard and issue: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/evals/toolcall-metrics and https://redwood.internal/issue/3214. Will follow up in the PR with log excerpts.

samir: TY all. Will update the issue with CI retrigger results.

dalia: Closing loop for now. If anyone sees a different failure mode ping here. :pray:
